items.title: Deliver one canonical Finding triage contract to every active REVIEW lane
items.context: Own all REVIEW-lane behavior and prohibitions in one canonical Agent contract: current review_run_start/reviewRunId/finding_add/review_pass_set protocol; independent evidenceState, severity, applicability candidate, disposition, and gate-impact axes; fail-closed unknown applicability; evidence-backed routing with owner; no reviewer repair, finding_dismiss, story_create, gap_log, severity rewriting, or unilateral scope expansion; distinct disproven, duplicate, and not_reproduced_under_current_witness outcomes; and future official signed defer_with_proof guidance limited to eligible verified applicable low/medium Findings while mandatory current-repair cases remain blocking. This proposal and Story are subordinate Agent-side projections of the Dynamic Finding execution plan; they do not amend that authority. Retired verdict vocabulary is historical evidence only and is never an active Task Context alias. Do not change runtime Finding schemas, handlers, predicates, process-fact registries, lifecycle gates, or the Dynamic Finding authority document in this Story. gap_log remains a main-Agent or human archive for Proof-or-Stop framework gaps, never general product-defect routing or backlog. Deliver the resulting contract identically to all five canonical proof-or-stop REVIEW lanes through both envelope paths and nowhere else.
items.userSees: Generated prompts for all five active REVIEW lanes visibly contain the same complete triage behavior in both supported envelope modes, while non-REVIEW prompts do not.

happy.desc: Assemble each of proof-or-stop-review-behavior, proof-or-stop-review-concept, proof-or-stop-review-docs, proof-or-stop-review-quality, and proof-or-stop-review-test-coverage in full-envelope mode and prove that every result contains exactly one byte-identical canonical Finding triage contract with the current review_run_start -> reviewRunId -> finding_add or review_pass_set protocol.

items.title: Align Story Owner, implementer, and reviewer authority guidance
items.context: Own only Story Owner disposition and implementer escalation guidance. The Owner returns applicable blockers to DEV, routes evidence-backed non-applicable work without unowned high/critical findings, fails closed when an otherwise-blocking finding has unknown applicability, and treats compatibility dismissal as temporary round/profile handling rather than applicability proof. The implementer preserves reproduction and impact evidence, reports out-of-item findings, and does not widen scope unilaterally.
items.userSees: Story Owner and implementer instructions distinguish current-Story repair from evidence-backed routing and prevent boundaryless scope expansion.

happy.desc: Inspect the published Story Owner and implementer guidance and verify it gives one complete normal path: current-Story regressions, acceptance blockers, and gate-truth blockers return to DEV; evidence-backed non-applicable issues are routed to a named owner without unilateral scope expansion; an implementer preserves reproduction and impact evidence and reports the issue to the Story Owner.

items.title: Prove prompt delivery, isolation, digest integrity, and adapter compatibility
items.context: Use RED then GREEN. Add adversarial tests covering all five canonical Proof-or-Stop REVIEW roles, both full-envelope and legacy-full-context assembly, non-REVIEW isolation, compatibility-dismissal wording, reviewer prohibition on gap_log as product-defect routing, distinct disproven/duplicate/not_reproduced_under_current_witness routing, English-only prose, stale in-flight reviewer redispatch guidance, and the subordinate Agent-side projection of Dynamic Finding authority. Retired verdict vocabulary may appear only as historical evidence or a negative mutation that the active Task Context guard must reject; it is never retained as an active alias, and this Story does not amend the Dynamic Finding authority document. Bind a must verification intent to prompt-full-context-envelope-smoke and inject retired or contradictory authority wording through Story, checklist, or verificationIntent Task Context; prove the complete assembled reviewer envelope rejects it independently of refreshed digest pins. Update approved digest pins, then run focused prompt tests, full-context tests, process/runtime contract checks, prompt baselines, type/build validation, and verify_codex. No runtime Finding schema, handler, predicate, process-fact, or lifecycle-gate implementation is in scope.
